_comment: Your A/B/C personas as a template. For each new industry, /find-leads copies this, adapts titles/keywords/what-they-buy to that industry, and asks you to approve before searching. company_rule: exhibitor_3plus | exhibitor | visitor | visitor_or_exhibitor | any. find_via: company_list (search people at known companies) | industry_search (search titles x sector x location).
product_context: Enfolo (enfolo.com) - helps sales teams keep the context of every buyer conversation (trade-show leads, long multi-touch deals). Validation goal: interview people who feel this memory/follow-up pain.

icps.name: Event-led sellers
icps.description: B2B companies that exhibit at 3+ trade shows a year; deals close ~2 months after the show.

icps.name: Procurement teams at events
icps.description: Buyers who walk shows to source capital equipment, components, tooling, raw-material suppliers.

icps.name: Continuous-cycle field sellers
icps.description: Steady pipeline of multi-month (>2 months) deals with many stakeholders; the memory problem is keeping context across dozens of touches.

icps.name: Inside / video-call sellers (SaaS, IT services)
icps.description: Comparison group only - tech sellers on video calls. Disabled by default for non-tech industries.
